rule.salary: Collect 200 units each time you pass Starting Plaza.
rule.jail: Stay at most 3 turns in the Guest House; pay 50 units to leave.
rule.house: Build only on a full colour group, evenly; a hotel follows 4 houses.
rule.mortgage: A mortgage pays half the price; redeeming costs a 10% fee.
rule.auction: A declined property goes to auction in 10-unit steps.
rule.bankruptcy: A bankrupt player settles with the creditor first, then the bank.
rule.end: The last player standing wins; ties are ranked by net worth.
rule.even-build: House counts within a group may differ by at most 1.
rule.tax: Tax cells pay the bank; optionally the Open Market pot.
